request.prompt: Cool, mysterious late-night jazz for stealing paintings from an empty art museum. 80 BPM, C minor, 4/4, steady tempo throughout. Soft brushed drums with sparse rim clicks, a slow deep upright bass, a breathy alto flute playing a sly five-note minor blues motif, shimmering Rhodes arpeggios, and a vibraphone with long tails. Elegant and slightly eerie, moonlight on marble. Structure: 8-bar A, 8-bar B, 8-bar variation of A, 8-bar C with the flute higher and quieter, then back to the top. No intro, no ending, no fade: it must loop seamlessly. Instrumental only, no vocals. No electronic beats, no synth pads, no four-on-the-floor kick.
